prompts.menu-training: Use case: stylized-concept, premium photorealistic military game key art. Generate one full bleed landscape 3:2 poster for the playable coastal training range of Depthline. An intimate cinematic view from a shaded, weathered coastal firing bay toward a large iconic red and chalk-ivory concentric bullseye on a sturdy timber stand in the sun, focal point at 53 percent across and 44 percent down. Place target boldly legible, around one quarter of the image height, emitting no light and caught by a low shaft of rich late afternoon sunlight; authentic chipped paint and scattered impact marks. Framed in lower left by the dark out-of-focus silhouette of a mounted practice gun extending inwards, nearby sandbags and worn timber. Open blue-green sea, windblown dune grass, coastal cliffs, distant firing lanes and a small orange windsock create depth, a quiet range before the first shot. Rich petrol shadows, warm copper and bleached linen, thoughtful art direction, photographic lens, fine film grain. Clear single focal point and cinematic optical separation; still reads strongly as a tiny card. Reserve calm outer right and dark lower strip for the real menu controls. NO lettering, words, numbers, watermark, logos, graphic borders, interface, people, overlays or crosshairs. A finished cinematic game poster, naturally lit and grounded.

Sophisticated muted olive, tan and blue-grey colors, readable silhouettes. No text, logos, HUD, crosshair, borders, watermark, excessive fire, giant soldiers or close-up faces. 3840x1920 landscape.
